question: Is our webhook still disabled? If so, please turn it back on.

model.source: recorded from claude-opus-5-5 through the anthropic provider

replies.text:
Your webhook was disabled, and I've turned it back on. wh_31c9 (https://hooks.kitewood.example/fernway) is now **active**, and its failure count is back to 0. Deliveries start again with the next event.

The last failure was a "timeout after 10.0s". Your endpoint has to reply with a 2xx status within 10 seconds, and failed deliveries are retried 3 times over one hour [help:webhooks@2#2]. After 50 failures in a row, Fernway disables the webhook again and emails the Admin who created it, which is you [help:webhooks@2#2]. It's worth checking that the endpoint replies within the time limit so this doesn't happen again.
